sloka: श्रोष्यते चैव काकुत्स्थः सर्वं निरवशेषतः ।चोष्टितं यत्त्वया देवि भाषितं मम चाग्रतः ।। ५.३८.६।।।।
transliteration: śroṣyate caiva kākutsthaḥ sarvaṁ niravaśeṣataḥ ।coṣṭitaṁ yattvayā devi bhāṣitaṁ mama cāgrataḥ ।। 5.38.6।।।।

translations.english: "O queen Kakutstha Rama will hear from me fully all that has been said and done by you in my presence without any omission.
